name: ReportTheft
description: Report the player for stealing from you: for taking much more than you allowed from your inventory, or something precious. This gives them a bounty in the hold, as for any theft that was seen, even without a guard around (it is gone if you die before it is reported). Only if someone of your personality and standing would: some let it go or only demand it back, others call it theft, and a dangerous or hot-headed person may attack instead.

source.description: The NPC who was stolen from.
